title: Create a mission-driven operator learning workspace for tss, adapting the teach skill at https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/tree/main/skills/productivity/teach. Teach users to discover, inspect, curate, resume, monitor, and troubleshoot agent sessions through a concise runbook, trusted annotated resources, canonical glossary, printable quick references, short practice lessons with reusable assets, and evidence-based learning records. Ground every exercise in actual tss commands and privacy-safe synthetic data; distinguish quick reference from durable learning, and keep hosted docs, telemetry, and agent-tool tutorials out of scope.
